message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** and can be submitted in several ways:

| Method | How to Submit | Contact / Link |
|--------|---------------|----------------|
| **Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **(404) 555‑1234** (replace the middle digits with the actual non‑emergency number). | (404) 555‑1234 |
| **311 Service** | Dial **311** from within Atlanta or use the 311 mobile app. The dispatcher will connect you to the appropriate department. | 311 |
| **Online Form** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and navigate to the “Noise Complaint” page. Fill out the required fields (date, time, location, description, contact info). | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| **In‑Person** | Go to the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s public service desk. Bring a written statement if possible. | City Hall – 55 Marietta Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

### What to Include
- **Date & Time** of the disturbance
- **Exact location** (address or intersection)
- **Description** of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
- **Duration** of the disturbance
- **Your contact information** (phone, email)

### Tips
- If the noise is ongoing, you may need to file a follow‑up complaint after the initial one is processed.
- For repeated disturbances, consider contacting the **Atlanta Police Department’s Community Policing Unit** for additional support.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like help filling out the online form or if you have any other questions!
